lede: In 2023, Opmet Osserpse became the festival's art director. The edition's painted palms, sea and red carpet went onto Hollywood billboards and badges, and onto a list of the world's best festival posters.
lede_src: lede, with "Dalton Corr" credited to Opmet Osserpse as in the credits
work: Posters, badges, merchandise, billboards, event invitations

HollyShorts-Wide-69942c.text: The look was developed with the festival's executive team, and it ran to dozens of original artworks.

IMG_2222-d42cab.text: A design team kept in step, so that every physical and digital piece matched.
